image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) is depicted in a low, ground-dwelling posture on dry, brownish grass. The bird displays characteristic bluish-black plumage with visible iridescent sheen on the neck. Prominent red eyebrow combs (caruncles) are visible above the eye, and the distinctive white undertail coverts form a bright patch at the rear. The tail feathers appear to curve outward, suggesting the lyre shape typical of display behavior. The beak is short and dark.
